issues: points: "HFCs have zero ODP but many have high GWP, so venting them is still illegal." -> The venting ban on HFCs does not come from their GWP. 40 CFR 82.154(a)(1) bans knowingly venting any non-exempt substitute refrigerant, whatever its GWP. Correction: "HFCs have zero ODP, but venting them is still illegal under 40 CFR 82.154(a). Many also have a high GWP."

summary[0]: "...why even ozone-safe refrigerants still may not be vented." -> This overstates the rule. 82.154(a)(1)(i)-(x) exempts some ozone-safe substitutes in listed end-uses (CO2, nitrogen, water, ammonia, and certain hydrocarbons such as R-600a/R-290 in listed uses). Correction: "...why non-exempt substitute refrigerants such as HFCs still may not be vented."
